channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Netanyahu to Winter: 'Show responsibility and withdraw'
item.description: Netanyahu urges Ofer Winter to withdraw from the Knesset race after bereaved families warn his candidacy could cost the right crucial votes.

item.title: Anti-Israel congressional candidate Brad Lander says he was detained by IDF
item.description: Far-left New York congressional candidate Brad Lander says Israeli forces detained him and dozens of activists during an olive harvest near Bethlehem.

item.title: Watch the dramatic rescue: Mother forgot toddler in car in Yavne while she was in Tel Aviv
item.description: A mother who traveled to Tel Aviv discovered that she had left her toddler in a car in Yavne. Police officers smashed a window and rescued him.

item.title: Right-Wing feud escalates: Likud, Ben Gvir accuse each other of harming the right
item.description: Likud accused Ben Gvir of spreading lies and helping the left. Otzma Yehudit responded with a sharp attack, claiming that Likud is working to establish a government without Ben Gvir.

item.description: Winter time returns: Israel to turn clocks back this weekend

item.title: Former AG admits police acted without approval in Netanyahu probe
item.description: Former Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit acknowledged unauthorized investigative activity, suspected media leaks were intended to pressure him, and said he was not informed of a potential conflict of interest involving a senior investigator.

item.title: Barbara discovered a shocking family secret that changed her life forever
item.description: A casual phone call exposed a Jewish identity hidden since the Holocaust, transforming the German-born artist's faith, identity, and destiny. Now, her extraordinary journey has brought her home to Israel.

item.title: 40 of 42 arrested Chabad students agree to enlist in IDF
item.description: In dramatic reversal, 40 Chabad-Lubavitch yeshiva students detained at Ben Gurion Airport for draft evasion agree to enlist in the IDF; two others remain in military prison.

item.title: From the front lines to the ballot box: IDF soldiers begin voting
item.description: From Mount Hermon to Eilat and across Israel's borders, IDF soldiers begin casting their ballots at 850 military polling stations, including mobile stations for troops on operational missions.

item.title: Islamic Jihad operative arrested in taxi sting
item.description: He appeared to be an ordinary taxi driver in Bethlehem, but Israeli undercover officers discovered him helping rebuild Islamic Jihad's infrastructure and finance terrorist activity.

item.title: Chronicle of a suicide
item.description: Western Europe has administered a lethal dose of poison to itself and is now writhing in convulsions. Opinion.

item.title: Haredi MKs fume at Chabad students' arrest
item.description: United Torah Judaism, Shas MKs blast enforcement system, claim elections interference, after 42 Chabad yeshiva students are arrested.

item.title: Is antisemitism on the ballot in the US midterm elections?
item.description: The philosophical dilemma for liberals is the belief that progressivism is an intrinsic Jewish value, and that surging leftist antisemitism must therefore be a reaction to bad Jewish behavior. Have they lost their minds as well as their memory? Opinion.

item.title: Report: Trump blocked new Israeli campaign against Iran
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu allegedly ordered the Israel Defense Forces to prepare for a large-scale military strike against Iran, but the operation was halted following opposition from US President Donald Trump.

item.title: Lebanese judge summons Hezbollah officials over seized explosives shipment
item.description: Lebanese authorities seek to question two Hezbollah officials after seizing half a ton of explosives, as the group demands the shipment be returned.

item.title: 'It’s too early': Trump holds off on endorsing Vance for 2028
item.description: President Trump declines to endorse JD Vance for 2028, saying it is too early to discuss the race.

item.title: ICC nominated for EU human rights prize despite US sanctions
item.description: The International Criminal Court is shortlisted for the EU's Sakharov Prize despite Trump administration sanctions targeting its actions against Israel and the US.

item.title: Davidi Ben Zion explains why he left Winter's party: I couldn't continue
item.description: A week after leaving Ofer Winter's party, Davidi Ben Zion explains his decision and admits he misjudged the party's chances of crossing the electoral threshold.
